def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Normalize species names to proper case
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    
    # Fix island typos
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'})
    
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (take absolute value)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    counts = df['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return counts
